notices.title: ADMINISTRATIVE UPDATE TO MARADMIN 189/26 POLICY ON SERVICE EXTENSIONS DURING INVOLUNTARY SEPARATION PROCESSING

judgment.summary: Extensions of service can no longer delay involuntary administrative separation, so Marines reaching EAS first separate on schedule.
judgment.audience: Marines in involuntary administrative separation processing
judgment.depends_on: If being processed for involuntary administrative separation and EAS arrives first
judgment.action: Expect separation on the scheduled EAS because extension requests are no longer accepted during processing.
judgment.evidence: Marines currently being processed for involuntary administrative separation under reference (a) who reach their Expiration of Active Service (EAS) prior to the completion of separation proceedings will be separated on their scheduled EAS.

notices.title: FISCAL YEAR 27 VOLUNTARY ENLISTED EARLY RELEASE PROGRAM

judgment.summary: Eligible enlisted Marines may request release up to 180 days before EAS, limited to 90 days for listed PMOS, with approval at the first GCMCA and not automatic.
judgment.audience: Active component FTAP enlisted Marines, EAS 1 Jan to 30 Sep 2027
judgment.depends_on: Only if active component FTAP enlisted with EAS 1 January to 30 September 2027
judgment.action: Submit a VEERP package with checklist and EAS calculator through the chain of command to the first GCMCA.
judgment.evidence: This message applies only to Active Component FTAP enlisted Marines with an EAS date between 1 January 2027 and 30 September 2027.
